verdicts.evidence: The u2 entry binds GITHUB_TOKEN and its prefix to the callback in j1, which reads that environment variable and tests startsWith (f1:1, s1).
j1 tests the prefix supplied by u2, and x2 exits when j1 is true; continuation therefore requires not_startswith the stated prefix (f1:1, s1, s2).
j1 reads the named process environment variable, so env_var fits (s1, f1:1).
U7 directly tests the lowercased locale returned by Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions() (s3).
U7 returns true for a locale starting with ru, and x2 exits on that return, making continuation the negative prefix case (s3, s4).
The tested property is the runtime locale, which fits locale_language (s3).
Both sites read language environment variables from the listed alternatives before applying their prefix tests; s6 additionally conditions its fallback on SystemRoot (s5, s6).
Both language fallback tests return true on a lowercased ru prefix, and x2 exits when U7 is true, so their continuation polarity is not_startswith (s5, s6, s4).
The fallback variables supply language settings, so locale_language fits (s5, s6).

The sequential exits require j1 to be false and every U7 locale test to be false before J2 reaches the region; the three recorded conditions therefore join with and and require all three (s2, s4, s7, s8).
The checks terminate the process before J2 continues into collection and token processing, so they enable the downstream work (s2, s4, s7, s8).
The decoy-token match causes an exit, consistent with backing off in an analysis environment; the locale checks also suppress execution rather than selecting a payload (f1:1, s2, s4).
Exiting on a specific decoy-token prefix supports anti_analysis for the combined gate, although the ru exclusions alone do not establish that purpose (f1:1, s1, s2).
J2 awaits x2 before the region, and its b call resolves to the declaration that calls X, whose declaration contains the fetch sink (s7, s8, s10, s11, s12, s13, s9).
X and b have additional callers in provider methods and network helpers; their complete reachability through dynamic method dispatch has not been resolved, so exclusivity is not established (f1:1).
The supplied sink sends the token in a network request and reads account metadata, but this witness contains no credential-read or process-creation sink to support all four behaviours (s9, s11, s13).
The test in _o checks whether the lock artifact exists before deleting it; the surrounding a1 implementation uses that artifact for duplicate-process suppression (s14, s19, f1:1).
z1 returns before spawning when __DAEMONIZED is set and passes that flag to the spawned child, directly implementing a re-entry guard (s15, s17).
a1 reads a stored process id, checks whether that process is alive, and otherwise replaces the lock with its own id; this suppresses duplicate execution (s16, s18, f1:1).
